content:
maya: Quick async — planning a small canary for the SDK 'so' shim that toggles structured-output / fncall compat. Need 1) canary audience rules, 2) telemetry + alerts, 3) CR review ping.

sandeep: +1. My vote: start at 5% for safety. Target only clients with client-sdk >= 1.12.0 and set an opt-in header so mobile stable users are excluded. Also add a hard guardrail: if parse failures > 0.2% in 5m, auto-fallback to legacy renderer.

julian: SGTM. For naming, prefer `so_compat_sdk_shim_v1` to avoid colliding with earlier flags. Keep it explicit in rollout config.

lisa: Heads-up: I'll enqueue the regression evals against the standard 10 prompt sets (chat, code, extraction, edge-cases). Need the rollout config so I can map splits -> eval groups.

ethan: Oncall ask: create an alert for 4xx/5xx on /v1/stream and /v1/chat if error rate increases by >0.5% vs baseline for 5m. Also watch token latency p95 > 200ms increase. Tag any alert with `so-shim-canary`.

maya: Draft rollout config below — feedback welcome. Note: audience is header opt-in + 5% traffic by client_id bucket.

```yaml
flag: so_compat_sdk_shim_v1
initial_percent: 5
audiences:
  - condition: client_sdk_version >= 1.12.0
  - condition: header x-so-shim-opt == 'enabled'
metrics:
  - parse_fail_rate: query: 'sum(rate(parse_fail_count[5m])) / sum(rate(request_count[5m]))'
  - err_rate: query: 'sum(rate(err_count[5m])) / sum(rate(request_count[5m]))'
fallthrough: legacy_renderer
rollback_thresholds:
  parse_fail_rate: 0.002
  err_rate_delta: 0.005
duration_checks:
  - name: initial_observation
    window: 120m
    action: expand_to_20_percent_if_ok
```

deploy-bot: deploybot: created canary rollout id cr_8821 (so_compat_sdk_shim_v1) targeting 5%; filter=client_sdk>=1.12.0 & header x-so-shim-opt==enabled; started by maya.

sandeep: CR ping @julian — PR #4532 is up: small shim + feature flag + tests. Tests include parse fallback unit and live smoke harness.

julian: skimmed PR, left a naming nit and one comment on docstrings. Will re-check once updates landed. :eyes:

maya: Operational plan: 1) start 5% for 2h, 2) evaluate telemetry + lisa's eval outputs, 3) if stable, expand to 20% for 6h, 4) if still stable, schedule gradual ramp. Rollback: flip flag or route traffic to legacy model and cut the SDK header.

ethan: I'll be watching the alerts and will run the smoke harness 15m after start. If anything crosses thresholds, I'll flip to fallback and notify paging.

lisa: Eval job queued: job_id 5598. Will post a short summary (pass/fail/regressions) in this thread once done.

maya: Thanks. If we don't see objections, plan to start at 20:00 UTC today. Ping me if you want earlier.

sandeep: one more thing — analytics team: please ensure cost metrics (tokens per response) are recorded; structured-output might increase token length in some cases.

julian: ack, will merge after nit fix and then we can schedule the canary window.

maya: Perfect. TL;DR: flag `so_compat_sdk_shim_v1`, 5% header+version canary, telemetry/alerts in place, CR + evals queued.

deploy-bot: deploybot: scheduled canary start at 1712347200 (20:00 UTC).

ethan: :thumbsup: I'll stand by.

lisa: will post eval results here.

maya: closing the loop — will post a short postmortem if we hit any rollback. Thanks everyone!
